findings.reason: F0003:S1:T2 supplies reported model-derived parameters and species-associated n. It does not state individual identifiers, sampling structure, parameter aggregation, uncertainty definitions, missing-value handling, detection limits or substituted-limit mean flags. Absence of these descriptions does not establish absence of censoring or missingness.
findings.needed_material: Retain the reported-parameter classification and obtain source-supported experimental-unit, uncertainty, missingness and assay-limit metadata where required; do not reconstruct individual records from this table.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T2:A22-A24 identify meropenem, plasma, single IV bolus dosing and animal characteristics. Total versus unbound basis, explicit unchanged-analyte composition and animal health, infection, immune, renal and pregnancy states are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Preserve the stated identities and retrieve or clarify the missing biological and analyte-basis metadata before any decision that depends on compatibility.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T2:A25 preserves seven abstract half-life numbers for six species and notes a different species order. Table cells C30-C32 state rabbit 20.8, beagle dog 40.8 and rhesus monkey 30.9 under T1/2 (min). The abstract sequence cannot be assigned or reconciled silently.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of the original abstract and Table 1 to establish the intended half-life values and species mapping. Preserve both representations and their original units pending review.

findings.reason: MI002 remains OPEN DEFERRED until the animal PK assessment, as specified under DR008. This item supplies reported rabbit model-derived parameters and a two-compartment description, but no rabbit concentration-time observations, pulmonary measurements or CSF measurements. Component eligibility and exploratory-only use remain unassessed.
findings.needed_material: At animal PK assessment, review the permitted component-specific evidence and record whether the rabbit parameter-only evidence supports a component or only exploratory constraints; retain MI002 until that outcome is recorded.

findings.reason: MI008, Support for individual PK variability, remains status DEFERRED, needed_at pk, resolution_status OPEN, with origin main:/missing_information/items/7. Species-associated n and fitted parameters in this item do not establish verified individual sampling, reported variability, variability-parameter provenance or empirical interindividual variability. The distinction between population variability and parameter uncertainty remains unresolved for DR010 and later PTA.
findings.needed_material: Assess the available experimental units and variability evidence during PK work; distinguish supported variability from uncertainty and retain any limitation for PTA. Record an explicit outcome at the PK step without treating this label as closure.

findings.reason: The item supplies species-specific reported parameters, model descriptions and study weight ranges, providing partial translation-input candidates. It supplies no binding measurements, urinary recovery or other direct renal-elimination measurements, justified physiological relationships, species-inclusion comparisons or input uncertainty. Cltot alone does not establish renal clearance.
findings.needed_material: Reuse these candidates with their definitions and limitations; obtain the additional source-backed binding, renal-elimination and physiological inputs required by the translation approach actually considered.

findings.reason: The table provides parameter candidates for six distinct species with printed units and model provenance. A23 reports weight ranges rather than individual weights or a documented representative weight for each parameter estimate. Biological states, uncertainty and cross-species equivalence of parameter definitions remain unresolved.
findings.needed_material: Retain the six-species candidate inventory without qualification. Establish the source-supported study weight basis required by any selected size-scaling approach and review parameter comparability; do not substitute range midpoints or typical weights.

findings.reason: Cltot values are AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE reported estimates for each species, with Table 1 provenance, 20 mg/kg single IV bolus context and ml/min/kg units. Overall clearance-input assessment remains UNRESOLVED: the salt/hydrate dose basis is explicitly unstated, total/free basis and uncertainty are unspecified, detailed estimation definitions are unavailable here, and no exposure course or AUC integration limits are supplied. Clearance selection and intended use are conditional downstream decisions.
findings.needed_material: If clearance is selected, retain the estimates as LITERATURE_REPORTED, NOT_RECALCULATED and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED; clarify dose and parameter definitions and obtain any underlying observations or methods needed for the intended use.

findings.reason: Concentration-time observations and sampling times were not located in this reviewed item. Co is presented among model-derived parameters, and AUC is a reported integral; neither establishes observed time-course records. Dosing and species metadata alone do not establish modeling-input coverage.
findings.needed_material: Locate permitted concentration-time observations with sampling design and provenance through the authorized coverage process, or retain parameter-only exploratory constraints for downstream assessment. This finding does not establish absence on other items.

findings.reason: The printed volume parameter is Vd (ml/kg), without a definition establishing Vss. No concentration-time or moment inputs are supplied. The context does not explicitly select Vss, so this item does not establish applicability or satisfaction of MC006.
findings.needed_material: Confirm whether Vss is explicitly selected. If selected, obtain a source-supported Vss definition and reported estimate or relevant observation and input-history evidence; preserve Vd without relabeling it.
